components.name: Scan Button
components.description: Primary action for committing a Pokémon lookup.
components.css: .ds-scan-button { min-width: 86px; height: 50px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; background: #1e4f7b; font: 900 0.78rem Geist, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-scan-button:hover { background: #173e61; } .ds-scan-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1b65a0; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-search-wrap { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px; border: 3px solid #17212b; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; } .ds-search-wrap:focus-within { outline: 4px solid rgba(59,130,196,.28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; padding: 0 13px; font: 750 1rem Geist, sans-serif; outline: 0; } .ds-search-submit { border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 16px; color: #fff; background: #1e4f7b; font-weight: 900; }

components.name: Type Capsule
components.description: Semantic type label with an optional defensive multiplier.
components.css: .ds-type-capsule { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 8px 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; color: #17212b; background: #b6a136; font: 850 0.72rem Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-type-capsule strong { min-width: 27px; padding: 4px 5px; border-radius: 999px; color: #fff; background: rgba(23,33,43,.72); text-align: center; font-size: .64rem; }

components.name: Matchup Tray
components.description: Verdict label paired with wrapping type capsules.
components.css: .ds-matchup-tray { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(120px,.46fr) minmax(180px,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: #ffe3df; font-family: Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-matchup-tray h3 { margin: 0; color: #17212b; font-size: 1.03rem; } .ds-matchup-tray p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #4e5963; font-size: .72rem; } .ds-type-capsule { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px; color: #17212b; background: #b6a136; font-weight: 850; }

components.name: Specimen Display
components.description: Cool scan-glass stage with a warm archive label.
components.css: .ds-specimen { overflow: hidden; border: 3px solid #17212b; border-radius: 16px; background: #dbeae3; box-shadow: inset 0 0 34px rgba(32,84,77,.12); font-family: Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-specimen > p { margin: 16px; color: #28524c; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .11em; } .ds-specimen-stage { min-height: 150px; } .ds-specimen-label { padding: 13px; border-top: 2px solid rgba(23,33,43,.22); background: rgba(255,255,255,.5); } .ds-specimen-label strong { font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-specimen-label h2 { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 2rem; }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like one compact piece of field equipment: a red outer shell contains a forgiving scanner, a cool specimen display, and a cream matchup report. Its personality comes from useful physical metaphors while the information hierarchy remains that of a fast reference tool.
keyCharacteristics: Pokédex-red device shell around warm paper and cool scan-glass surfaces.
One dominant task per surface: identify a Pokémon, then read its matchup.
Tactile seams and labels without decorative dashboard chrome.
Type colors are semantic data, never arbitrary accents.

rules.name: The Semantic Type Rule
rules.body: The eighteen Pokémon type colors belong only to type capsules and the data they identify; they do not become general UI accents.

rules.name: The One Big Voice Rule
rules.body: Only the primary task headline reaches display scale; report headings and data labels step down decisively.

rules.name: The Contained Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadow establishes the complete device or a temporary overlay; content trays stay flat.

dos: Do treat type color as data and preserve each capsule's readable text contrast.
Do keep the search-to-answer path visible within one surface.
Do let live Pokémon artwork sit on the cool scan-glass stage.
donts: Don't use the official Pokémon logo or present the utility as official.
Don't distribute type colors into unrelated controls or decoration.
Don't add generic dashboard cards, metrics, navigation chrome, or extra routes around the core lookup.
Don't give every inner surface a shadow; the physical hierarchy depends on restraint.
